description: Create character sheets for the people found in a project's material — the writing counterpart to lab_cast_gaps. Creates at most 6 per call and binds each to the project. Costs an LLM run per call. Run lab_cast_gaps first if you want to see what it would create. The sheets it creates have NO reference image: each one still needs lab_generate_character_reference before lab_generate accepts it as `character_refs`. Fail-open: no script or no AI key returns an EMPTY `created` list with a `note`, not an error. Each created sheet carries a `casting` note (world, the one deviation from the obvious face, why). `herkunft: true` additionally lets the casting propose the person's ORIGIN as that one deviation (skin, hair and eye tone only) — off by default, because it changes who a named character is; the note names it.

herkunft.description: Allow the origin as the casting deviation (default false). Only turn it on when the person asked for casting against type by origin.

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string
